sources.title: Leveraging Large Language Models for Enhanced Classification and ... - MDPI
sources.snippet: This study explores the potential of large language models, especially ChatGPT-4, in fire classification tasks. In particular, we utilize ChatGPT-4 for the first time to develop a classification approach for fire incidents. We evaluate this approach using two benchmark datasets: the Forest Fire dataset and the DFAN dataset.

sources.title: SAM-FireAdapter: An adapter for fire segmentation with SAM
sources.snippet: SAM-FireAdapter leverages the adapter concept to adapt the foundational model to fire segmentation tasks effectively. By combining task-specific insights with SAM's robust feature extraction capabilities, SAM-FireAdapter achieves higher precision fire segmentation.
